info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API provides a comprehensive overview of the status of retail orders within the system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve up-to-date information on various orders, helping businesses monitor and manage their order flows effectively. Typical consumers of this API include retail managers, analysts, and inventory systems that require insights into order processing statuses. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer service through better visibility into order states.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of a specific order by providing the appropriate order identifier. The status will reflect the latest processing state of the order in the system.

requestBody.description: Request to fetch the status of orders. This request body should include the necessary parameters to retrieve the current status of specified orders.

204.description: The request was successfully processed, but there is no content to return.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the status of orders. It is expected to be a string value that indicates some specific state or status.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the request.

resultId.description: Identification number for the result associated with the request.

state.description: The current state of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_204.description: Response schema for the status of orders after a GET operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInformation.description: Information related to the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Specifies the time, in milliseconds, that the request took to process on the server. This is useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
